chapterTitle: Principle 6: Feedback: Don't dodge the punches

support.text: Principle 6: Feedback: Don't dodge the punches
Feedback means exposing work to correction rather than dodging it.

safeExtensions: Feedback works when real work is exposed to correction.
Avoidance can leave persistent flaws protected from response.
Correction can sharpen learning when it is tied to the target task.
prohibitedDrift: claims that all criticism is equally useful
